_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP6 K2 (one turn, one block), LANE ONLY, DEV build (npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev). Run x2 consecutive: node scripts/debug/so-run-header.mts capture --label sp6-k2 -> node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes <n> --repeat 2 --strict --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator' test/scenarios/live-v25-09-sp6-k2.json -> node scripts/debug/so-run-header.mts diff <capture>. Three scripted /cp set commits hold tension far below the waystation's critical target, so the second one releases complication c1. Then, in order: a quiet generation (/gen), an impersonation (/impersonate), a loud turn, a second loud turn. Every generation request is recorded at the fetch layer (/api/backends/*/generate). PASS = the complication text is in exactly one request, the first loud one, and nothing is pending after it. Extraction is pinned to SCENE_NONE (no memory-model request can be mistaken for a generation); the replies are real. The fixture switches settings.spikes.sp6Complications ON and its last step OFF; after a FAILED run set it off by hand and reload the page (the fetch wrapper).
